title: The 2-sided CycleMin seam classification produces a new local inequality
statement: Classifying the local parity itinerary on both sides of a CycleMin n produces a seam type, or a cell inequality for a legal type, that is not cycleMin_starts_two_odds / cycleMin_not_end_odd / cycleMin_not_odd_even / exists_cycleMin_last_odd_run / last-even / trailing-evens / oo_suffix_threshold, and that type empties or tightens a bound for a reason that is not an archived cell.
counterexamples: the 2+2 window is exactly {OE|OO, EE|OO}; return-O has no predecessor >= n
33 OE valleys and n(n^2+n+1) EE chains occupy both legal types at n=10^6+1
launch OOE and OOO both occur on OO-realizers in [13,2001)
every listed inequality is an archived Lean first/last-letter or cell lemma
notes: Phase 0 only. Not a reopen of the OE-corridor leftover-killer. The two-type list is a REPARAMETERIZATION of existing Lean. No finance, no K=11, no L=55293, no floor raise. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no new Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: n=10^6+1 occupancy; odd return at 13,101,10^6+1; launch split on odds in [13,2001); EEE witness; OEE search p_cap=q_cap=40
